description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at a cutoff of 10 with respect to the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the 'Number of queries used during inference (S)' on a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis shows 'MRR@10' on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines: 'DPR w/o query', 'DPR w/ corpus expansion', 'DPR w/ document expansion', and 'DPR w/ asymmetric expansion'. The 'DPR w/o query' line is depicted in black with a solid style and no markers, remaining constant at approximately 34.3 across the entire x-axis. The 'DPR w/ corpus expansion' line is red with circle markers and a solid style, starting at around 35.4 at x = 1 and increasing to approximately 35.7 by x = 4, then remaining relatively stable until x = 10, where it is around 35.7. The 'DPR w/ document expansion' line is green with triangle markers and a solid style, beginning at about 34.7 at x = 1, increasing to around 35.0 at x = 2, and remaining relatively stable until x = 10, where it is approximately 34.9. The 'DPR w/ asymmetric expansion' line is blue with star markers and a solid style, starting at around 34.7 at x = 1, peaking at approximately 35.1 at x = 3, and then declining to about 34.2 at x = 10.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at a cutoff of 10, with respect to the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the 'Number of queries used during inference (S)', using a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis shows 'MRR@10', also on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The first line is 'DPR w/o query' with black, solid, without markers, depicting a constant value of approximately 34.3 across the entire x-axis. The second line is 'DPR w/ corpus expansion', red, with circle markers and a solid style, beginning at an approximate value of 35.1 and increasing steadily to a value of around 36.0 by the x-axis end. The third line is green, with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at about 34.8 and showing a consistent upward trend, ending at around 35.5 at x = 10. The fourth line is blue, with star markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 34.8 and showing a sharp decline to about 34.0 towards the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
